evidence_items.claim: HSBC participated in FCA/BOE Digital Regulatory Reporting pilot phases 1 and 2 (2018-2019) with 6 other UK banks
evidence_items.excerpt: Two phases of the DRR pilot have been completed, involving collaboration between the FCA, BOE and seven banks: Barclays, Credit Suisse, HSBC, Lloyds, Nationwide, Natwest and Santander.
evidence_items.caveats: Historical pilot (2018-2019). Does not confirm current DRR/CDM production usage.

evidence_items.claim: Jeroen Krens (HSBC MD, COO Markets & Securities Services) elected ISDA Board Chair effective January 2025
evidence_items.excerpt: ISDA announced its Board of Directors elected Jeroen Krens as its new Chair. Krens is Managing Director, COO, Markets & Securities Services at HSBC Bank Plc and has been on the ISDA Board since 2016.
evidence_items.caveats: ISDA Board Chair is governance role. Does not directly indicate CDM adoption.

evidence_items.claim: HSBC is NOT listed as a FINOS member at any tier (Platinum, Gold, Silver)
evidence_items.excerpt: FINOS members page lists Platinum (Citi, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, UBS, etc.), Gold (Deutsche Bank, Lloyds, NatWest, etc.), Silver members. HSBC is absent from all tiers.
evidence_items.caveats: Despite ISDA Board Chair role, HSBC has not joined FINOS.

evidence_items.claim: Jakir Alam from HSBC participated in ISDA Future Leaders in Derivatives program (2024 cohort)
evidence_items.excerpt: Jakir Alam, Program Manager, New Product Development, Markets & Securities Services at HSBC, participated in the ISDA Future Leaders in Derivatives (IFLD) program. The cohort's whitepaper examines collateral efficiency and liquidity resilience.

null_results.implication: HSBC is not a FINOS member despite having ISDA Board Chair. Unusual pattern for G-SIB.
